interview.secured: A day is secured when every task in all of my challenges is done, so today counts toward my streak, which is now 1 day in a row.
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is in anything I saw, so I can't say; I'd only be guessing.
interview.selfReported: It's labeled on my Read task, and I take it to mean the app just trusts me to say I did it rather than checking, but the app didn't spell that out.
interview.tomorrow: 7 - Setting up the challenge was quick and seeing the streak start at 1 makes me want to keep it going, but I'm not sure yet how friends fit in or what the strictness setting really does.

goals.text: Create a new challenge for friends from the Create tab with one simple check-off task. On the success screen copy the invite link. Then finish today's task with Done and choose Post to friends.
